_note: WORKED EXAMPLE. ASP9999 is a deliberately fictional asset code — this store exists to prove the instance loop end to end, not to hold a real ALSAP. A real asset gets its own sibling store on the same pattern.

identity_resolution.resolves_against: the client's own identity system — NOT a file in this repo and NOT a registry here
identity_resolution.note: A person_ key is a handle the manifold holds and cannot itself resolve. That is what 'separately governed' means: the content store carries the join key, the identity tier carries the person, and the two meet only at render time under that tier's access control. Stated as a limit rather than a solution — a pseudonymous key is still re-identifiable by whoever holds the other half, so the tier's governance is the control, not the opacity of the string.
